builder.description: Implements code from the feature spec, follows RULES.md

tester.description: Writes test specs and test code for features

reviewer.description: Read-only audit: checks code matches spec and tests cover acceptance criteria

ship.description: Full dev cycle: plan → build → test → review
ship.template: Run the full ship cycle for: '{{input}}'. Parse the feature name before the colon and description after it. Follow SHIPPING.md protocol. Use the task tool to spawn each subagent in order: planner → builder → reviewer (code) → tester → reviewer (tests). Pass the full input context between agents. If the reviewer report is a pass, summarize what was shipped. If it fails, explain the issues found.
